info.title: d365-xref
info.description: Cross-reference graph for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations X++ code. Resolves who-calls-what, who-extends-what, and downstream impact across the whole AOT: method callers, field usages, references, class/interface hierarchies, Chain-of-Command and event-handler extensions, cross-module dependencies, and full impact analysis.

post.description: Cross-reference / call-graph analysis for D365FO X++. Use this tool when the user asks about: dependencies and call chains (who calls a method, what a method calls), references and usages of an object or field, class inheritance and interface implementors, Chain-of-Command and event-handler extensions on standard objects, cross-module dependencies, and impact analysis before a change (the full downstream dependency tree). Do NOT use for table field metadata (use d365-kb) or for security/permissions (use d365-sec).

scopes.api://trelleborg.onmicrosoft.com/sp-tis-: Access D365FO MCP as the signed-in user
